name: Shop and Establishment Licence (Gumasta)
description: Master guide for obtaining a Shop and Establishment registration or intimation under state labour laws with verified rules and fees.

national.title: How to Get Shop and Establishment Licence in India (2026)
national.summary: Master procedure for obtaining a Shop and Establishment certificate under state labour laws. Verified guide covering employee count rules, storefront photo requirements, municipal portal submission, and digital certificate download.

steps.title: Determine Registration Category Based on Worker Count
steps.description: Count total persons employed in your commercial premises. Establishments with under ten workers submit an intimation, while larger units require formal registration.
steps.calloutText: Many states allow small shops with fewer than ten workers to submit free online intimations without renewal fees.

steps.title: Capture Front View Photo with Name Signboard
steps.description: Take clear daylight photographs of your shopfront displaying the trade name signboard. The signboard must display the regional state language prominently alongside English.
steps.calloutText: Statutory rules mandate that business signboards display the official state language in equal or larger font.

steps.title: Compile Employee Roster and Working Schedule
steps.description: Prepare a roster listing all workers, daily opening and closing hours, meal intervals, and weekly closing days. Ensure statutory rest periods comply with state labor codes.

steps.title: Access State Labour or Municipal Corporation Portal
steps.description: Visit your municipal corporation portal or state labour e-governance platform. Create an employer account using your mobile number and PAN card.
steps.where: State Labour Portal or Municipal Corporation (services.india.gov.in)
steps.calloutText: Select the correct municipal ward matching your commercial electricity bill to route your application properly.

steps.title: Complete Online Registration or Intimation Form
steps.description: Fill details regarding nature of business, date of commencement, employer particulars, and property ownership. Specify whether the premises are owned, rented, or leased.

steps.title: Upload Supporting Documents and Storefront Photos
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of employer Aadhaar, PAN card, rent agreement with landlord NOC, and electricity bill. Attach clear shopfront photos showing the bilingual signboard.
steps.where: State Online Portal or Municipal Kiosk

steps.title: Pay Prescribed Statutory Municipal Fee
steps.description: Pay the statutory municipal fee based on your employee slab using Net Banking, UPI, or credit card. Establishments submitting Form A intimation pay zero statutory fees.
steps.calloutText: Save your fee payment receipt and application reference number for audit verification.

steps.title: Download Gumasta Registration Certificate
steps.description: Download your official Shop and Establishment Registration Certificate or Form A acknowledgement. Print and frame the certificate for display in a visible spot inside the shop.
steps.where: State Labour Portal or Municipal Counter
steps.calloutText: Labor laws require the certificate to be displayed prominently near the main customer entrance.

documentRequirements.name: Identity and Address Proof of Employer
documentRequirements.description: Self-attested copy of Aadhaar card, Voter ID, or Indian Passport of the business owner or managing partner.

documentRequirements.name: PAN Card of Employer or Business Enterprise
documentRequirements.description: Permanent Account Number card of the proprietor, firm, or registered corporate entity.

documentRequirements.name: Proof of Commercial Premises (Electricity or Tax Bill)
documentRequirements.description: Latest municipal property tax receipt or commercial electricity bill showing premises address and owner name.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Recent bill not older than 2 months

documentRequirements.name: Storefront Photograph with Regional Language Signboard
documentRequirements.description: Clear color photograph of the front exterior showing the shop entrance and signboard in regional state script.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Clear digital photo in JPEG format

documentRequirements.name: Registered Rent Agreement and Landlord NOC
documentRequirements.description: Valid rent agreement executed on stamp paper accompanied by a signed no-objection letter from the property owner.

documentRequirements.name: Partnership Deed or Certificate of Incorporation
documentRequirements.description: Registered partnership agreement for firms, or MCA Certificate of Incorporation for registered companies.

documentRequirements.name: Fire Safety NOC or FSSAI License for Food Units
documentRequirements.description: Prior safety clearance from fire department or food safety authority for restaurants and hospitality units.

fees.label: Online Form A Intimation Fee (0 to 9 Workers)
fees.notes: Shops with fewer than ten workers file online intimation free of charge under modern state shops acts.

fees.label: Municipal Registration Fee (10 to 19 Workers)
fees.notes: Statutory municipal registration fee for commercial establishments employing between ten and nineteen workers.

fees.label: Municipal Registration Fee (20 or More Workers)
fees.notes: Statutory fee slab for large commercial establishments employing twenty or more workers.

rejectionReasons.title: Signboard Lacks Prominent Regional State Script
rejectionReasons.description: State regulations mandate the local language script on business signboards. Non-compliant signage leads to inspection notices and rejection.
rejectionReasons.solution: Repaint or replace the signboard to display the state official language in prominent font alongside English.

rejectionReasons.title: Submitting Blurred or Cropped Exterior Shop Photographs
rejectionReasons.description: Photos that do not show the full shop entrance, street view, and signboard are rejected by municipal inspectors.
rejectionReasons.solution: Take a high-resolution daytime photograph from across the street capturing the entire storefront clearly.

rejectionReasons.title: Expired Lease Agreement or Missing Landlord NOC
rejectionReasons.description: Commercial rental agreements that have expired or lack an explicit owner consent clause prevent establishment verification.
rejectionReasons.solution: Execute an updated lease agreement or obtain a fresh notarized consent letter from the property owner.

rejectionReasons.title: Discrepancy Between Declared Workers and Physical Muster
rejectionReasons.description: Declaring fewer than ten workers to avoid registration fees when field inspections reveal more staff constitutes statutory fraud.
rejectionReasons.solution: Declare the exact number of all full-time, part-time, and contract workers accurately.

rejectionReasons.title: Submitting Application to Incorrect Municipal Ward
rejectionReasons.description: Routing applications to the wrong local ward causes delays as inspectors transfer files across administrative boundaries.
rejectionReasons.solution: Check your municipal property tax bill to identify your exact administrative ward circle before applying.

rejectionReasons.title: Operating Hazardous or Food Businesses Without Prior Licenses
rejectionReasons.description: Restaurants, bakeries, or manufacturing units applying without FSSAI or fire clearances are halted during scrutiny.
rejectionReasons.solution: Obtain preliminary safety clearances or licenses from relevant sector departments prior to submission.

faqItems.question: What is a Shop and Establishment Licence?
faqItems.answer: It is a statutory commercial registration issued by state municipal authorities regulating worker hours, holidays, and workplace conditions.

faqItems.question: Do small shops with under 10 employees need formal registration?
faqItems.answer: In many states including Gujarat, shops with under ten employees need only a free online intimation rather than formal licensing.

faqItems.question: Is annual renewal required for Shop and Establishment registration?
faqItems.answer: Under reformed state laws such as Gujarat 2019 Act, certificates carry lifetime validity with no annual renewal required.

faqItems.question: What is the rule regarding language on business signboards?
faqItems.answer: State regulations require business signboards to display the local state language in prominent lettering alongside other languages.

faqItems.question: Can I operate a business without a Shop and Establishment licence?
faqItems.answer: No. Operating an unregistered commercial establishment violates state labor statutes and attracts financial penalties.

faqItems.question: Is a physical inspection always conducted before issuing the certificate?
faqItems.answer: No. For small shops, intimation receipts are issued instantly online. Inspections are conducted post-registration on a risk-assessment basis.

faqItems.question: Is this certificate needed to open a business bank account?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Banks routinely ask for the Gumasta certificate or intimation receipt as official proof of business entity and address.

faqItems.question: How quickly can I obtain the registration certificate online?
faqItems.answer: Online intimation for small units is instant. Formal registration for larger units typically takes three to seven working days.
